system_prompt_style.note: Prompts are made up of an instruction, few-shot examples and a CoT part, loaded from prompts/ and few-shots/ files (see file tree). prompter.py was not in the bundle, so the rendering code was not seen.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
The names of entities and relations from knowl-
edge bases are indexed in an ElasticSearch 7.5.2
server for text matching.
env_context_strategy.note: Candidate URIs are retrieved from the knowledge base by lexical Elasticsearch matching and inserted into the prompt. This is KB context, not repository context, so the value is the closest fit.

context_compaction.note: The pipeline code (prompter.py, lm.py) was not in the bundle, so there was no place to check for history handling.

observation_format.note: SPARQL results come back as JSON bindings. How they are placed into prompts was not seen, so raw_text is inferred.

tool_call_format.note: Triad is a fixed pipeline in which the model outputs text such as triples or SPARQL. No tool-call parser appeared in the bundle.

tool_count.note: No tool registry was visible. The KB functions are invoked by the harness, not by the model.

edit_primitive.note: This is a KBQA system with no file editing. There was no tool registry in the evidence to cite.

protocol_standardization.note: requirements.txt was not shown, so dependencies could not be grepped.

timeouts.note: There is also an Elasticsearch timeout of 120 in config.py. No run-level timeout was seen, but the run loop was not in the bundle.
